),
t2 AS (

    t.order_purchase_timestamp,
    LAG(t.order_purchase_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_state, t.customer_unique_id ORDER BY t.order_purchase_timestamp) AS prev_purchase
  FROM t
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT customer_state, customer_unique_id
  FROM t
  GROUP BY customer_state, customer_unique_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
)
SELECT

  AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, t2.prev_purchase, t2.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS avg_repurchase_interval_days
FROM t2
JOIN qualified q
  ON q.customer_state = t2.customer_state AND q.customer_unique_id = t2.customer_unique_id
WHERE t2.prev_purchase IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t2.customer_state
ORDER BY avg_repurchase_interval_days;

쿼리 작성: WITH m AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_state,
    c.customer_unique_id,
    COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-02-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_state, c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT
  customer_state AS state,
  COUNT(*) AS unique_customers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_cnt >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_customers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_cnt >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS repeat_rate
FROM m
GROUP BY customer_state
ORDER BY state;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  c.customer_city,
  COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(o.order_delivered_customer_date, o.order_purchase_timestamp) <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_3_days,
  SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(o.order_delivered_customer_date, o.order_purchase_timestamp) <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS within_3_days_rate
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'

쿼리 작성: WITH s AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_state AS state,
    c.customer_unique_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_city) AS city_cnt
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'

  GROUP BY c.customer_state, c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  c.customer_state,
  COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_approved_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_approved,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_approved_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS missing_rate
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-05-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-06-01'

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  c.customer_state,
  COUNT(*) AS qualified_orders,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN DATE(o.order_approved_at) = DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
       AND DATEDIFF(o.order_delivered_customer_date, o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 1
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS same_day_approved_next_day_delivered,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN DATE(o.order_approved_at) = DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp)
       AND DATEDIFF(o.order_delivered_customer_date, o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 1
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END
  ) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS rate
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-03-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01'
  AND o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY rate DESC;

쿼리 작성: SELECT

  SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL AND o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_undelivered_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL AND o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
